title: Chintamani Library v2.8.18 — Complete Universal QR Portal & Admin Portal Synchronization
releaseNotes: WEB ADMIN PORTAL REPAIR: Fixed authentication token extraction so admin login succeeds immediately with persistent session.
PAYMENT VERIFICATION APPROVALS: Fixed API routes and HTTP methods for 1-tap Approve & Reject actions with full audit sync.
CAMPUS FILTER BAR: Added instant 1-tap [All Campuses] [Khalilabad] [Mehdawal] filter in Member Directory so all member records are visible globally.
MEMBER DIRECTORY PERSISTENCE: Universal QR portal submissions immediately create active Member records, Subscriptions, and occupied seat assignments in the database.
COMPLAINTS & ISSUES SYNC: Complaints submitted from Universal QR cards appear in real-time across both Web Admin Portal and Mobile App.
ADMINISTRATOR CREDENTIAL SYNC: Guaranteed production admin access with automatic credential validation on backend startup.
